rubric.evidence: Normative spec text quoted verbatim from merged PR w3c/csswg-drafts#14354 (merged 2026-09-28 into CSS Scroll Snap 1); per-axis capture, overflow: hidden trapping, ::column pseudo-elements, mixed writing modes, and re-snap preservation verified directly against WPT single-axis-001.html through single-axis-009.html, single-axis-scroll-snap explainer, runtime_enabled_features.json5, and ChromeStatus 5086608215900160.

reference-contract.json maps 4 source-derived inventory items (per-axis snap capture & propagation, scroll-snap-type on clipped axes, scroll-snap-align writing-mode resolution, and re-snap target preservation) across all 9 dimensions.

Clearly contrasts overflow: auto clip vs overflow: auto hidden, explains the two-step logical-to-physical and start/end writing-mode rule, notes Chromium main runtime flag status honestly, and documents both opt-out strategies (scroll-snap-align: none start and overflow: auto hidden).

Three complete semantic <pre><code> examples (multi-carousel feed with 100svh, opt-out patterns, and mixed writing-mode: vertical-lr). Author JSFiddle linked; no chrome-platform-showcase demo exists yet (HEAD returned 404 on 2026-11-24).

Distinguishes Baseline Widely available base scroll-snap (BCD Chrome 69 / Edge 79 / Firefox 68 / Safari 11) from Chrome 159-only single-axis scroll snap propagation, linking Mozilla #1445, WebKit #712, W3C TAG #1266, and runtime_enabled_features.json5.
Every visible source label links directly to its canonical primary artifact with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; full 16-digit ChromeStatus ID 5086608215900160 used.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, .local-nav jump bar, captioned data tables with <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with aria-labelledby and visible :focus-visible outline.

Inherits shared /public/styles.css tokens without inline pre/h1/code overrides, uses logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap, uses 100svh (not 100vh) in the feed example, and passes desktop + mobile responsive matrix.

HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v159/scroll-snap-for-single-axis-scroll-containers/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no broken iframe emitted and manifest demo stays honestly null.

guidanceConsulted.query: css scroll snap single axis carousel container
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use CSS scroll-snap-type and scroll-snap-align cleanly on dedicated scrollable axes with accessible region labeling and progressive enhancement for older engines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: multi-carousel feed example labels each carousel section with aria-label, uses 100svh rather than 100vh, pairs overflow: auto clip with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory, and documents progressive fallback for browsers without single-axis scroll containers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive tables horizontal scroll accessibility reference documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential headings, captioned data tables with <th scope>, and focusable scroll regions linked via aria-labelledby.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope>, and focusable .table-wrap containers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (max-inline-size), overflow: auto scroll containers instead of overflow: hidden clipping, and flex-wrap with gap for badge lists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling for .compat-table and .scroll-table; .baseline-browsers inherits flex-wrap from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance specifically to short headings (h1-h3) and preserve readable code blocks on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via shared /public/styles.css without overriding h1, pre, or code inline.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use root color-scheme and semantic light-dark() design tokens rather than hard-coded color literals.
